name: Team Charter
notes: Every label prints with a trailing colon, dropped here. Team Values and Principles, Meeting Guidelines and Communication Guidelines each print a box with five numbered lines ('1.' to '5.'); Decision-Making Process, Conflict Resolution Process and Other Agreements are open boxes. The signature block is two ruled columns headed 'Signature:' and 'Date:' with nine blank lines each, one per team member, and no printed signer names, so columns holds the two printed headings and rows is empty. Page 2 has the title bar but no Project Title / Date Prepared line.
